content.title: Material Word Passage | Fixed Direction and Portrait Resolution
content.summary: An urban planner crosses four material word zones and resolves at a portrait beyond the gallery. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and one forward spatial route are established before the first word crossing. + Every word is a physical volume with readable foreground, interior and background relationships. + Each new word changes material and semantic duty without resetting character identity or travel direction. + At least one visible body-to-letter contact proves the typography belongs to the same world. + The final portrait occurs beyond the last word and carries one exact original master title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original clearly adult urban planner with a copper braid, charcoal coat, teal scarf and square silver glasses at the entrance to a long concrete typography gallery. Continue without reversing geography through a translucent amber "FORM" and a rough blue-stone "BUILD", using one foreground letter edge to motivate each transition. End at the gallery exit with a clean close portrait and the exact compact title "CITY IN WORDS"; hold long enough to read and do not copy any source name, styling or caption.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and one forward spatial route are established before the first word crossing.
Every word is a physical volume with readable foreground, interior and background relationships.
At least one visible body-to-letter contact proves the typography belongs to the same world.
The final portrait occurs beyond the last word and carries one exact original master title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An urban planner crosses four material word zones and resolves at a portrait beyond the gallery. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年时装人物沿固定方向穿过由巨型实体短词构成的空间；每个词用不同材质承担一段地理和动作职责，镜头持续证明人物与字块的前后关系，最后以完整人像和原创主标收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and one forward spatial route are established before the first word crossing.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and one forward spatial route are established before the first word crossing."

invariants.rule: Every word is a physical volume with readable foreground, interior and background relationships.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every word is a physical volume with readable foreground, interior and background relationships."

invariants.rule: Each new word changes material and semantic duty without resetting character identity or travel direction.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each new word changes material and semantic duty without resetting character identity or travel direction."

invariants.rule: At least one visible body-to-letter contact proves the typography belongs to the same world.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "At least one visible body-to-letter contact proves the typography belongs to the same world."

invariants.rule: The final portrait occurs beyond the last word and carries one exact original master title.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final portrait occurs beyond the last word and carries one exact original master title."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
